title: Quiz: Functions and Procedures
description: Check your understanding of Functions and Procedures.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in SQL?
questions.explanation: In SQL, -- marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: Function vs procedure — key difference?
questions.correctAnswer: Functions return a value; procedures perform actions

questions.question: True or False: Return value is the defining difference.
What is the main purpose of the Functions and Procedures technique shown in this lesson?
questions.explanation: It exists to help you functions and procedures effectively.

questions.question: In SQL, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
